{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Exclude rows where biomarker_baseline == -999
df_clean = df[df["biomarker_baseline"] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq
# Sort by sample_seq descending, then drop duplicates on patient_id
df_dedup = df_clean.sort_values(by="sample_seq", ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset="patient_id", keep="first")

# Final count of unique patients
n_patients = len(df_dedup)
print(n_patients)"}
